since_stage128.what_moved: GATE_STATUS.md: the gate-6 rho control. The Stage 108 online wall crossing was measured against koblitz_rho_fixture, which inverts once per step, canonicalises by squaring chains, stores every point and runs on one thread (about 9.5 us a step). A batched signed-Frobenius rho (one inversion shared across 64 walks, normal-basis orbit key, distinguished points only; aburan28/cryptanalysis suite/examples/koblitz_batched_rho.rs, PR #54) on the same target and host solves in a median 0.49 s on 1 thread and 0.20 s on 4 threads against 17.3 s for the selected direct, every run verified by [d]G=Q. That is 46.3M support queries against about 0.56M rho steps; the query count r/(n|F|) grows as r^(2/3) against rho's r^(1/2). The host is an M4 Pro without the x86 PCLMUL paths, so the EPYC ratios need their own rerun
